caption: The drawing depicts a piece of wooden furniture, specifically a tall chest of drawers, in a natural light brown wood color with a visible grain pattern. The furniture consists of two vertical sections: an upper section and a lower section. The upper section contains five rows of drawers, with each row having two brass drawer pulls in the shape of ornate, symmetrical handles. The bottom section features three rows: the top row with two side-by-side drawers, the middle row split into three smaller drawers, and the lower row as a single, long drawer, each with matching brass pulls. The base section has a decorative, scalloped apron and four cabriole-style legs that curve outward and then inward, ending in pad feet. The edges and corners of the chest have simple, straight lines, and the overall style appears symmetrical and balanced. The background is a plain, light beige color.
title: Highboy
